## NINEONELABS Drawer Navigation Component - Comprehensive Analysis

I've completed a thorough exploration of the drawer navigation component in the NINEONELABS project. Here are all my findings:

---

## 1. SCSS Files Related to Drawer

**File: `c:\Users\edn_y\renew_nineonelabs\resource\scss\layouts\_drawer.scss`** (599 lines)

This is the primary drawer SCSS file containing:
- **Root selector**: `.no-drawer` with nested BEM classes
- **State classes**: `is-open`, `is-animating-in`, `is-barba-leaving`, `is-drawer-text-reveal`
- **Layout structure**: 
  - `&__inner` - scrollable inner container with overflow-y handling
  - `&__container` - main content wrapper with padding
  - `&__center` - grid layout (8fr 4fr) for GNB + Address sections
  
- **Text reveal system** (lines 87-161): Stagger animations for masking text reveal with transitions on drawer open/close
  - `&__reveal` and `&__reveal-inner` - text masking wrapper
  - Stagger delays: 0.055s per GNB item, 0.48s base for address blocks
  - Duration: 0.78s ease: `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`

- **GNB (Global Navigation)** (lines 190-290):
  - `&__gnb-link` - main navigation links with hover text-shadow effect
  - `&__gnb-sub-link` - subnavigation links
  - Link hover effects: color change + `text-shadow: 0 0 fluid(20, 40) rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4)`
  - Active state: `&__gnb-link.is-active` applies color without text-shadow

- **Badge system** (lines 291-360):
  - `&__badge` - badge container with border, transparent background initially
  - `&__badge-inner` - flex wrapper with gap
  - `&__badge-corner` - corner bracket styling (color-mixed)
  - **`&__badge-rect`** (lines 330-333) - Position relative, flex-shrink 0
  - **Badge hover state** (lines 357-360):
    ```scss
    &__gnb-item:hover &__badge-rect span,
    &__gnb-item:focus-within &__badge-rect span {
      opacity: 0.9;
    }
    ```
  - On hover: badge border-color changes, background gets subtle tint, transform translateY(-2px)

## 2. Filter Rect Component

**File: `c:\Users\edn_y\renew_nineonelabs\resource\scss\components\_loop-filter-rect.scss`** (54 lines)

Complete implementation of the loading indicator:

```scss
.no-loop-filter-rect {
  --loop-filter-delay-base: 0s;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 0;
  flex-shrink: 0;

  span {
    width: fluid(3, 5);
    height: fluid(3, 5);

```

**Animation**: `no-loop-filter-rect-pulse` - 1.2s linear loop with opacity pulse (0.16 → 1 → 0.16)
- Each span has staggered animation-delay: 0s, 0.18s, 0.54s, 0.36s (2x2 grid pattern)
- Respects `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` by disabling animation

**Usage locations**:
- `resource\scss\pages\_main.scss` (lines 186-188, 323-325, 843-845): In works/portfolio sections
- `resource\scss\pages\_sub.scss` (line 627): In sub-page filter sections with gap: 0 override

## 3. TypeScript Drawer Hover Interactions

**File: `c:\Users\edn_y\renew_nineonelabs\resource\ts\ui\Drawer.ts`** (384 lines)

Core drawer management class implementing:

- **Initialization** (lines 41-66):
  - Static `getInstance()` factory method
  - Config: selector, triggerSelector, revealGroups
  - Drawer config from `DOM_CONFIG.drawer`

- **Mount phase** (lines 93-121):
  - Trigger click listener binding
  - ARIA setup (aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-hidden)
  - MagneticCornerTracker initialization for hover effects on links

- **Visibility management**:
  - `_show()` / `_hide()` methods toggle `is-open` class
  - Sync ARIA attributes on visibility change
  - Keydown handler: Escape key closes drawer

- **Transition animations** (lines 182-334):
  - `runOpenTransition()`: BlockOverlay.playIn() → BlockOverlay.playOut() → text reveal masking
  - `runCloseTransition()`: Text reveal out → BlockOverlay.playIn() → remove is-open class → BlockOverlay.playOut()
  - `runTextOutOnly()` / `runTextOutThenClose()`: For Barba page transitions

- **Text reveal ordering** (lines 270-286):
  - Reveals groups in order: GNB → GNB-sub → Address
  - Stagger delay: 70ms per item, 120ms gap between groups (from MASKING_ANIM config)

- **Lock/unlock mechanism** (lines 359-370):
  - Static `attachLock()` / `releaseLock()` for scroll locking during drawer open
  - WeakMap-based release callback storage

**File: `c:\Users\edn_y\renew_nineonelabs\resource\ts\ui\Header.ts`** (183 lines)

Header toggle orchestration:
- Manages trigger button + drawer + panel coordination
- Stores panel visibility state before drawer opens (lines 18-19, 90-93)
- Restores panel visibility after drawer closes
- Handles click-outside and Escape key closure
- Manages transitioning state with queued visibility changes

**File: `c:\Users\edn_y\renew_nineonelabs\resource\ts\components\Button.ts`** (lines 145-508)

**MagneticCornerTracker class** - handles hover interactions on drawer GNB links:

- **Hover event binding** (lines 414-491):
  - `mouseenter`: Calls `hoverIn(box)` with `measureBox()` results
  - `mouseleave`: Calls `hoverOut()` with deferred execution via FrameScheduler
  - `mousemove`: Tracks pending move, applies pull offset to element + text

- **Hover animation** (lines 368-407):
  - `hoverIn()` (368-391): GSAP tweens to link bounding box with 0.42s duration, ease: power3.out
    - Animates corner path H state (x0, y0, x1, y1, L)
    - Progress tween: p 0→1 over 0.32s
  - `hoverOut()` (393-407): Animates progress p back to 0 over 0.25s, ease: power2.in

- **Box measurement** (lines 343-366):
  - `measureBox()` uses `getBoundingClientRect()` to calculate bounding box
  - Applies gap offset to x0, y0, x1, y1
  - Caches results in `rectCache` Map, cleared on scroll/resize

- **Mouse move handling** (lines 439-489):
  - Calculates relative position ratio: (clientX - centerX) / halfWidth
  - Applies pull offset: `bx = rx * halfWidth * pullFactor`
  - Uses FrameScheduler to batch move calculations
  - Updates corner arm visualization based on mouse proximity

  - Only flushes SVG updates when `dirty = true`
